description: This source file defines the CalendarService class, which implements calendar-related functionalities such as fetching events and adding new events using EventKit. It manages permission checks, event range resolution, and calendar selection.

classes.name: CalendarService
classes.description: A final class that provides methods to fetch and add calendar events using EventKit.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within a specified date range, limited by the provided limit, and returns them as a payload.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event with the specified parameters and returns the created event as a payload.

methods.name: resolveCalendar
methods.description: Resolves and returns an EKCalendar instance based on provided calendar ID or title; falls back to default calendar if necessary.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Resolves start and end Date objects from ISO8601 strings, defaulting to current date and a week ahead if unspecified.
